invariants.rationale: The method returns the result of atlas.findRegion(regionName), which likely returns non-null for valid atlas data.
The input parameter 'name' is used to compute a region name and must not be null to avoid NullPointerException.
'name' is used to lookup regions and usually is required to be non-empty for a successful lookup.
The returned result is exactly atlas.findRegion(parseRegionName(name)), as per method body.
